calculation.primary_vocabulary_identity: QAC STEM segment LEM value (exact extended-Buckwalter canonical lemma)
calculation.why: QAC lemmas group inflectional variants; derivationally distinct vocabulary, including derived verb forms, uses distinct canonical lemmas
calculation.known_before: union of canonical vocabulary items from earlier study days (higher-numbered surahs)
calculation.new_today: vocab(current surah) minus known-before; Surah 1 is not in the known set on Day 113
calculation.root_metric: exact QAC ROOT values on STEM segments, independently accumulated
calculation.raw_stem_metric: supplementary diagnostic only; not the product vocabulary count
